verdict.rationale: The evidence documents API endpoints for subscribers, events, broadcasts (reviewing history, creating and scheduling sends), chat and data deletion, but none that return campaign or flow performance metrics such as opens, clicks or revenue. Revenue attribution to emails and flows is claimed only as an in-app feature, and 'review broadcast history' is not performance-metrics export, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards
